name: _PyEM_TrampolineCall_JS
gaps: For a type outside its ten (loader.call_any) a wasm exception can not cross the Python host frame: the guest traps (the ten types are called in wasm and pass exceptions).
evidence: _wasm.py TRAMP_WAT: the ten types it tests are called in wasm; any other type goes to loader.call_any (_host.py _call_any/_js_call: the callee's own type, arguments as Numbers, ToInt32 of the result). evidence: adapter.c sc_recvfrom -> _host.py _n_recvfrom: the sender's address is written (sockaddr_in/in6 and its length; 0 for a connected stream), MSG_PEEK, MSG_WAITALL, MSG_DONTWAIT, MSG_TRUNC; a datagram is read whole so that a short buffer truncates it as the kernel does. name: __syscall_recvmsg
evidence: adapter.c sc_recvmsg -> _host.py _n_recvmsg: ALL iovecs are filled in order, msg_name/msg_namelen written, msg_flags carries MSG_TRUNC, msg_controllen stays 0 (no ancillary data on the host side), as Pyodide. iovlen above 1024 is EMSGSIZE, a bad iovec EFAULT, before anything is read.

name: __syscall_sendmsg
evidence: adapter.c sc_sendmsg -> _host.py _n_sendmsg: msg_name honoured, all iovecs joined in one send; control data (SCM_RIGHTS...) is EOPNOTSUPP, never dropped (no host primitive carries it). A non-blocking socket or MSG_DONTWAIT never waits on the host: a partial count, or EAGAIN.

name: __syscall_sendto
evidence: adapter.c sc_sendto -> _host.py _n_sendto: the destination sockaddr (in and in6) is honoured, MSG_* bits are translated by name (MSG_OOB, DONTROUTE, EOR, MORE; MSG_NOSIGNAL moot, DONTWAIT by the adapter), one the host lacks is EOPNOTSUPP; a non-blocking socket that cannot take data is EAGAIN. A non-blocking socket or MSG_DONTWAIT never waits on the host: a partial count, or EAGAIN.

name: __syscall_shutdown
evidence: adapter.c sc_shutdown -> net.shutdown (the host's shutdown(2)); a non-socket is ENOTSOCK, an unopened descriptor EBADF; shutdown(SHUT_WR) then recv gives the rest and b'' (Linux semantics; Pyodide's JS has no shutdown).

name: __syscall_socket
evidence: adapter.c sc_socket (a placeholder WASI descriptor, SOCK_NONBLOCK kept), _host.py _n_socket: AF_INET and AF_INET6 (the host's own answer if it has no IPv6: EAFNOSUPPORT), SOCK_STREAM/SOCK_DGRAM (other types ESOCKTNOSUPPORT, Pyodide: EINVAL), a protocol that does not fit the type EPROTONOSUPPORT (as Pyodide). Probe: fused and dynamic. Every host error is translated by name to Emscripten's errno (ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP is 138), also the Windows WSAE* numbers (_host.py guest_errno); a net operation never raises into the wasm: EFAULT for a pointer outside the memory, EIO (logged) for the unforeseen.

name: __syscall_setsockopt_host
